BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to ferry system accountability; adding a newsection to chapter 47.60 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.60 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A ferry partnership advisory committee must be created bySeptember 1, 2009, to recommend annually ferry fare schedules to thecommission. The executive committee of the Washington state ferryusers shall make recommendations for appointments to the committee.The commission shall appoint nine members to the committee, all of whommust be permanent residents of ferryserved communities. Members ofthe committee shall serve without receiving compensation. (2) Appointments to the ferry partnership advisory committee mustinclude: (a) Two ferry riders; (b) Two representatives of local governments; (c) Two representatives of commercial users; (d) Two ferry system employees who work aboard the ferries; and (e) One representative of the United States navy. p. 1 HB 2314 (3) Members of the ferry partnership advisory committee shall servethreeyear terms; however, the initial terms of members may be shorterto stagger the expiration of terms. (4) The ferry partnership advisory committee shall serve in anadvisory capacity to the commission on all matters related to thedevelopment of ferry fares including, but not limited to: (a) Pricingand service strategies; (b) the costeffectiveness of ferry systemoperations as it affects fare schedules; and (c) fare and serviceinnovations that may help control system costs and fares. (5) Meetings of the ferry partnership advisory committee must bepublic and must be timed to allow for ample public input into the ferryfare setting cycle. (6) Staff support, to include the provision of data and analysis offerry system fares, usage, and costs, must be provided to the ferrypartnership advisory committee by the department in conjunction withthe commission. (7) In setting ferry fares, the commission shall considerrecommendations of the ferry partnership advisory committee.
This act may be known and cited as theWashington ferry system accountability act.
